about: Proposed region definitions for detailed maps of Austria: nine states (Bundesländer), one region each, with the whole country as one region as an alternative. See docs/REGIONS-AT.md. Not read by any code.

codes.proposal: ISO 3166-2:AT codes, AT-1 to AT-9; AT for the whole country if it is one region, or eu-at if pull request #84's country codes land.
codes.why: A hyphenated code keeps Austrian regions apart from US state codes. A bare AT is not in STATE_CODES (engine/address_search.py). The numbers match BEV's state key BL_KZ, checked in the boundary files.
codes.verified: Search only: the Umweltbundesamt code list and Wikipedia agree; the ISO site was not opened.

terrain.dataset: Digitales Geländemodell (DGM) Österreich, 10 m, from airborne laser scanning
terrain.notes: Bare earth. ZIP with GeoTIFF. Record last updated 2021-04-15. Download 1,938,031,542 bytes (about 1.9 GB), file dated 2019-06-18, read 2026-11-19.
55 tiles on a 50 km EPSG:3035 grid; one tile measured 7,635,990,378 bytes.
From aerial photographs; not updated since 2020. DGM_R25.tif is 786,013,673 bytes.

water.notes: Federal river network (WFD keywords). From v19, stretches that are not waters under the Water Act are marked; leave them out.
Rivers and streams, water supply lines, springs (Quellen), waterfalls. GeoPackage 396 MB. Lakes not listed in its description.

dams.publisher: linked from BMLUK under the ATCOLD heading
dams.notes: Coordinates and terms of reuse not checked.

crops.verified: INSPIRE record for 2025-1 opened 2026-11-17; 2026-1 sampled through the OGC API
crops.notes: Crop per field (snar_code, snar_bezeichnung), e.g. 901 WEIN, 813 MARILLEN, 817 TAFELÄPFEL, 818 TAFELBIRNEN, 820 ZWETSCHKEN. Vector, not a raster. Only fields declared for EU subsidy. GeoPackage ZIP 1,255 MB. Full code list not read.

buildings.notes: Complete nationwide building polygons with ground, mean and maximum height (LoD1); linked to the address register through the AGWR object number. GeoPackage 2,646 MB.

places.notes: Over 220,000 names: settlements, areas, mountains, glaciers, waters, field names. GeoPackage 59 MB. CSV tables of mountains and lakes with heights.

addresses.publisher: Overture Maps Foundation, from BEV through OpenAddresses
addresses.notes: "Austrian Address Register", CC BY 4.0, accessed by Overture 2026-11-17 (page read 2026-11-19; it said 2026-10-15 on 2026-11-17; the page refreshes this date). Region field for Austrian rows not checked.
CSV in a 118,545,233-byte ZIP. Credit line: "© Österreichisches Adressregister, Stichtagsdaten vom TT.MM.JJJJ".

pois.dataset: OSM amenities as the US map uses them

pois.notes: CSV and GeoPackage, files dated 2026-11-11. BMI says all Polizeiinspektionen stay staffed in a blackout as contact points (oesterreich.gv.at, last updated 2026-02-16). The list has 924 rows of every office kind; only ArtLang = Polizeiinspektion (744 rows, counted 2026-11-19) carries that promise.

pois.dataset: Liste der Krankenanstalten in Österreich (XLSX, Stand 18.09.2026)
pois.notes: Offered for reuse ("steht zur Weiterverarbeitung als Download zur Verfügung") as a voluntary service; no licence or credit line named. Coordinates not checked.

addressing.order: Street, then house number/staircase/door, then postcode and town ("Grünwaldweg 16/13/5, 2283 Obersiebenbrunn", Austrian Post, Richtig adressieren, February 2020). Where an address occurs twice in one municipality, the locality replaces the municipality or goes on its own line before the postcode.
addressing.notes: normalize() and norm() keep only a-z and 0-9 ("Grünwaldweg" becomes "gr nwaldweg"); is_address_query() needs a number first and stops at a slash, so "16/13/5 Grünwaldweg" is not an address; "1060 Wien" is read as house number 1060 on a street called "wien"; _parts() reads only a five-digit postcode as the last word; tools/build_addresses.py keeps only country = 'US'. Tried in this repository on 2026-11-17.
